svg.title: Current RMD-X results in the original three-series semicircular radar style
svg.desc: Static shapes, fonts, markers, legend frame and scale inherited from the original Mo.pptx. Only series data, point labels and necessary accurate series names are updated. AP in percent, radial tick maximum 50; points above 50 are not clipped.
